book.name: Yohane
book.title: Nhalo ghwa Maha handa paghutyekitwe na Yohane Yohane

content: Yesu kangupopohelwa mahuta akwo Betania
Manjubha sita yikali na kikubhukubhu kya Pasaka, Yesu kakighenda ku Betania kwakatamiteghe Lasalo, ywene Yesu kakinhyuha.
Akwo bhakintendekehela mulyo ghwa makimuhi, Malita kakibhegha kangunkeyela Yesu, Lasalo kakibhegha yumoo ywa bhala bhaatamite mu mulyo papamu na Yesu.

Mbole Malia kakitola kyupa kiibheghite na mahuta gha kunungila gha ngalabha ngulu ghaatendikihitwe kwa mmela ghwa nalido, kakinpopohela Yesu mumaghulu ghake na kakinpukuta kwa hwili hyake. Na kitutubhi kyoha kikinungila luhumba lwa mahuta.
Hino, Yuda Simoni Isikaliyote, yumoo ywa ahundwa bhake ywene ywakapala kunkiluka Yesu, ndo kakilongela,
“Kya bhuli mahuta agha ghangatupeghite mbiya ngenju ya kunhomba mundu kwa ngungwa yimo, na ngalabha ahyo yangakamuhitwe kapukwa?”
Naywo Yuda kakighalongela agha chepa kwa kuabhonela luhungu kapukwa, ngati kiyaha kakibhegha mwihi. Naywo ndo ywakakamulite nhaku ghwa mbiya na kuhitumila ghweka chake.
Yesu kakiayanga, “Nkotoke kunghaha nndala ayu! Munneke kiyaha kambopohela mahuta kwakya linjubha lya kukulilwa nenga.
Kiyaha kapukwa mmegha nabho manjubha ghoha peni nenga maabhegha ng'obhe papamu na nenga manjubha ghoha.”
Lukila lwa kunkoma Lasalo
Akaayahudi ayoloho pabhayihwite kukita Yesu kakibhegha ku Betania, bhakihika chepa kwakya kummona Yesu ghweka chake, ngati na Lasalo ywene Yesu kakinhyuha.
Kya habhu hilongohi bha mandundame bhakitendekeha lukila lwa kunkoma Lasalo bhubho,
kiyaha kubhukana na mihalo ya kuhyuhwa Lasalo, Akaayahudi ayoloho bhakialema hilongohi bhabhe, bhakintughila Yesu na kunyubhalila.
Yesu kanguyingila ku Yelusalemu kwa chekwa
Kilabhu yake lumati lukulu lwa bhandu bhaahikite ku kikubhukubhu bhakiyihwa kukita Yesu kakibhegha munjila kuhika ku Yelusalemu.

Hino bhakitola mapanyu gha misalisi bhakibhuka kughenda kunkingama kunu paakweha malobhe bhakilongela, “Tuntike Chapanga! Kanonelwe aywo yunakuhika kwa makakala gha Bambo. Kanonelwe Mutwa ghwa Akaaisilaeli!”
Yesu kakimmokola mwana kaputa, na kakihubhuka munng'ongo handa bhula malembo mughalongela.
Kalongohi ahundwa bhake Yesu bhakimanya ng'obhe milando ayi, peni Yesu pakanyahulitwe kala, ndo bhakikulungwa kukita milando ayi yikityekwa kwakya ywombe, na kukita bhandu bhakintendela ywombe.
Lumati lwa bhandu luubheghite papamu na Yesu pala pakankemite Lasalo kuhuma mu lindogholo, na kunhyuha, bhakighendelela kualongela bhangi kila kyakakitendite Yesu.
Kya habhu lumati alwo lwa bhandu lukinkingama, kiyaha bhakiyihwa kukita Yesu kakighutenda nhabho aghwo.
Habhu Afalisayo bhakighombana bhombe kwa bhombe, “Mungubhona, kukita tunguhotola ng'obhe kutenda kilibhi kyohele kangi! Nnole, bhandu bhoha bhanguntuughila ywombe!”
Amoo bha Akaagiliki bhangupala kummona Yesu
Apo ku Yelusalemu bhakihika bhubho amoo Akaagiliki kutundamila mu Kikubhukubhu kya Pasaka.
Abho bhakinng'endela Filipi nkola nnima ghwa Betisaida ya ku Galilaya, bhakinng'ombela, “Bambo tungupala kummona Yesu.”
Filipi kakighenda kunng'ombela Andelea, mbole bhoha abhili bhakighenda kunng'ombela Yesu.
Yesu kakiayanga, “Lisaa lya kukwehwa nenga Mwana ywa Mundu lihika kala.
Kulyaghila nunguaghombela. Lupunje lwa ngano kyanga kuponeka mu lutupi na kuhwegha lwahighala handa lupunje. Peni paluponeka na kuhwegha, lwapambika mbunje nyoloho.
Mundu ywohele ywakaghupala ubhumi ghwake kataghuhobheha, naywo ywakaghukalalila ubhumi ghwake mu nnima aghu kataghubhika kwakya ubhumi ghwanga kupela.
Mundu ywohele ywakapala kundumikila nenga yingunkwiliha kanndughile, ili kabheghe papamu na nenga pohele pambala kubhegha. Mundu ywohele yakandumikila nenga Tate ghwangu katantetekeha.”
Yesu kangulubhulila kulinga kiho kyake
“Hino mwoyo ghwangu ghungubhaghaya munu, hino nenga nongele niki? Peni yingunnogha ng'obhe kulongela, ‘Tate, ghunopole mulisaa ali’ Kiyaha kulyaghila nenga hika munnima aghu ili mbamatike.
Tate, lihina lyako likwehwe!” Ndo likihika lilobhe kuhuma kunani kwa Chapanga, “Nilikwiha kala, na ndalikweha kangi.”
Lula lumati lwa bhandu luubheghite pala lukiyihwa. Nalwo lukilongela, ali lilobhe lya njahe, bhangi bhakilongela, “Ndumitumi ghwa kunani kwa Chapanga kanguyobhela naywo!”
Peni Yesu kakiaghombela, “Lilobhe ali liyihwanika kwakya mwenga, na chepa kwakya nenga.
Hinu ndo lisaa lya kutoswa nnima aghu, na nkulu ghwa nnima aghu katataghwa panji.
Nenga panyinulighwa kunani mwa nnima, ndabhahuta bhandu bhoha kwa nenga.”
Yesu kakilongela agha pakilaha kiho kya bhuli kyakalonda kuhwegha.

Lula lumati lwa bhandu likinnyanga, “Tuyihwanila kuhuma mu malaghilo kukita Kilisito Nkombohi katalama manjubha ghoha ghangapela. Hinu ghungulongela bhuli ghwenga Mwana ghwa mundu katayinulighwa kunani mwa nnima? Aywo mwana ghwa mundu ndo ghani?”

Ndo Yesu kakiayanga, “Lung'ali lukali papamu na mwenga kyamandina, nnyendelele kutyanga nalwo lukali palung'aliha ili lubhindo lukotoke kubhahotola, kiyaha mundu ywakatyanga mu lubhindo kaamanya ng'obhe kwakaghenda.

Muluyubhalile lung'ali alwo, pammegha papamu nalwo, ili mmeghe bhana bha mulung'ali.” Akaayahudi angughendelela kulema kuhyubhalila Mbole ya kulongela agha Yesu kakibhuka, kakilihiha ili akotoke kummona.
Hata mbole ya kutenda mihabho hyoha ayi mu ulongolo ghwabhe, bhombe bhakinyubhalila ng'obhe,
ayi yikibha ili litwihilike lila lilagho lya mbuye Isaya lyakalongelite.

content.text: Kangi Chapanga kammoneha ghani makakla ghake?”

content: Habhu bhakinhyubhalila ng'obhe Yesu, kiyaha mbuye Isaya kakilongela pamoo pangi.

content.text: ili akotoke kubhona kwa meho ghabhe
na akotoke kungilimbuka, ili hotole kualamiha,

content: Mbuye Isaya kakilongela agha kiyaha kakighubhona ukulu ghwa Yesu na kakilongela mihalo ya ukulu aghwo.

Hata naha, ayoloho bha hilongohi bha Akaayahudi bhakinhyubhalila Yesu, Peni bhakilongela ng'obhe pakindandabhanji kukita bhakinhyubhalila, kiyaha bhakiyoghopa Akaafalisayu kuabhinga mu nyumba hya ngonganilo.
Hilongohi abho bha Akaayahudi bhakipala kutikilwa na bhandu na chepa kutikilwa na Chapanga.
Yesu kakihika kualopoha bhandu munnima
Mbole Yesu kakilongela kwa lilobhe likulu, “Mundu ywohele ywakanhyubhalila nenga, kangunhyubhalila ng'obhe nenga ghweka changu, ngati kangunhyubhalila yula ywakanaghihite bhubho.
Ywoheli ywakamona nenga kungummona na yula ywakanaghilite.
Nenga hika pa nnima handa lungali, ili mundu ywohele ywakanyubhalila kakotoke kuhighala mulubhindo.
Na ywohele ywakaghayihwa malagho ghangu peni kangughakamulila ng'obhe, nenga ndantosa ng'obhe. Kiyaha hika ng'obhe kubhatosa bhandu bha munnima, ngati kubhalopola.
Peni bhoha bhaanganite nenga na kulema malagho bhaatoswa mu linjubha lya toso kwa malagho gha hoto ghanighalongelite!
Ayi ndo hoto, kiyaha ningulongela ng'obhe kwa kulamula numwene, ngati Tate ywangu ywakanaghihite ndo ywakangwilikihite niki kya kulongela na mumbala kulongela.
Na nenga nungumanya kukita ngwiliho yake yingughegha ubhumi ghwangapela ghwa manjubha ghoha. Hino, nenga nungulongela ghala ghweka ghakanaghilite Tate nighalongele.”
